Run `loom ai orient` if you have not done so this session, and `loom ai runs` to see the open runs; `loom ai start "a name"` opens a new one. Nothing sets `$LOOM_RUN`, so pass `--run` with the run's name on every command that takes it. Read `ai/modes/{mode}.md` and follow it exactly. Begin with the mode's first command.{target_line}
